name: VESPER Metallic Silver
description: Metallic silver earcups meet a black padded headband in VESPER, an understated take on over-ear headphone design.
fullDescription: VESPER pairs rounded silver earcups with dark cushioning and a clean headband profile. The contrast between the light outer housings and black interior gives the headphones a precise, graphic appearance. Exposed connecting arms connect the two elements and introduce a more mechanical detail. The result is a restrained design built around proportion, contrast and a metallic visual finish.

specifications.label: Design details
specifications.value: Rounded earcups, padded headband and slim connecting arms
